summary: Russian forces launched 323 drone attacks across Ukraine on September 13, with 10 drones hitting targets despite air defenses downing 310. Strikes hit facilities in Volgograd, Kharkiv, and Odesa, targeting chemical plants and infrastructure. Air threats remain high-level for Kyiv with potential for combined strikes.
key_points: Russian forces launched 323 drone attacks across Ukraine on September 13 between 6:30 and 18:00, including 14 reactive drones (Source: @kpszsu/78115).
Air defenses downed 310 drones during the period, with 10 drones hitting targets in Ukraine (Source: @kpszsu/78115).
Ukrainian forces struck the Slavynsk-EKO oil refinery in Volgograd, damaging key chemical processing equipment (Source: @UkraineNow/84074).
Russian drones attacked a fuel depot near the Poland border on Volyn, approximately two kilometers from the border (Source: @eRadarrua/113150).
Multiple reactive drones launched from Kharkiv region heading toward Kyiv and Chernihiv regions (Source: @kpszsu/78137, @kpszsu/78119).
Air threat level for Kyiv remains at medium-high, with potential for combined strikes (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74467).
Ukrainian drone collection campaign launched for military units in Zaporizhzhia direction (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74453).

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces launched 323 drone attacks across Ukraine on September 13, with Ukrainian air defenses downing 310 drones but 10 reaching targets. Strikes hit critical infrastructure including the Slavynsk-EKO oil refinery in Volgograd and fuel depots near the Polish border. Air threats for Kyiv remain at high level with potential for combined strikes.

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces are escalating drone attacks across Ukraine with 323 launches on September 13, overwhelming Ukrainian air defenses despite downing 310 drones. The targeting of critical infrastructure including oil refineries and fuel depots indicates a strategy to degrade Russia's war machine while creating humanitarian crisis conditions. Air threats for Kyiv remain at high level with potential for combined kinetic strikes, suggesting coordinated operations with potential negotiating implications.
sections.regional_response: International response includes Polish Foreign Minister confirming Poland will not block Ukraine's EU accession, with potential cluster munition discussions in negotiations (Source: @UkraineNow/84080). UN Development Programme warns Ukraine faces its most difficult winter since war start, with risk of humanitarian catastrophe if Russian strikes cut electricity and water supplies (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33229). German AfD leader demands return of Ukrainian men, threatening to end payments and support (Source: @UkraineNow/84084).
sections.intelligence_notes: Ukrainian drone collection campaign specifically targets military units in Zaporizhzhia direction, indicating operational focus on defending against Russian assaults (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74453). Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner stated Ukraine needs to retreat to Moscow-designated lines for agreement (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33216). Zelensky ranked 21st on Jerusalem Post's list of most influential Jews, described as Jewish face of Ukrainian resistance (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33224). Ukrainian budget could lose 70 billion hryvnias due to Russian strikes on businesses (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33215).
